subject: Slider with more than two values

messages.author: 041f4347d6c4723f
messages.subject: Slider with more than two values
parts:
I want to have a slider which allows to have more than two values. In the range between a minimum and a maximum value I would like to be able to select 3 or more points.
Foe example I would like to have something similar

sliderInput("slider2", "",
            min = 0, max = 100, value = c(25, 50, 75))
)

Clearly it doesn't work.
Do you have any suggestion to solve the problem?

messages.author: f1a78b77bed56547
messages.subject: Re: Slider with more than two values
parts:
I have the same need. For a workaround I use two sliders stacked on top of each other, like this:

sliderInput("id1","",min=0,max=100,value=c(25,75))
sliderInput("id2","",min=0,max=100,value=5)

The nice thing is that when you leave the label off (and generate a using tags$p separately), the widgets are nice and compact and close together, so this is not a bad solution. 

I would much more prefer it if there were a slider with more than two values tho.

Jonathan
